notes.title: GizmoVR v1.0.8 Update + Patch Released
notes.notes:
General fixes and improvements:
   Bugfix: wrong frame packing for YouTube videos
Browser improvements:
   Added support for pop-ups
   New tab opens in the current window
   Bugfix: browser cannot be launched if application path contains Unicode characters
   Bugfix: loading website favicon error
Virtual desktop usability improvements:
   Bugfix: spacebar behavior in the virtual keyboard error
Player improvements:
   Bugfix: failure to turn off video stereo mode
   Added support for VLC libraries
   Now if the video cannot be played back, the player will try to re-open it in different quality
   Added support for .flv and .wmv formats
   Bugfix: error when trying to run subtitles in Chinese, Japanese and Russian
   The player now remembers the previously selected audio track for video
Camera module improvements:
   Bugfix: automatic camera hide
   Bugfix: launch error after app restarts

notes.title: GizmoVR v1.0.5 Update Released
notes.notes:
General fixes and improvements:

Virtual keyboard compatible with integrated browser and virtual desktop
Bugfix: running 2 application instances immediately after installation
Bugfix: objects in the room overlapping recenter panel
Bugfix: no animation after interaction with center of the Vive controller touchpad

Browser improvements:

Updated browser engine
Added frequently visited websites panel
Browser can open any address, not just tailored websites
Added scroll functionality for Vive, Oculus Touch, Oculus Remote and Xbox controllers

Player improvements:

Added audiotrack switcher panel

Bigfix: incorrect display of loading video
Localization of Back button fixed

Virtual desktop usability improvements:

Added key combinations for virtual keyboard
